## Summary

- [ ] Links to active `spec.md`, `plan.md`, and `tasks.md`
- [ ] Describes user-facing change or template/governance change
- [ ] Calls out out-of-scope work

## Validation

- [ ] Tests or checks run:
- [ ] Manual verification:
- [ ] Skipped checks and reason:

## Quality Gates

- [ ] Requirements are traceable to implementation
- [ ] Tests match the feature risk
- [ ] Security/privacy risks are addressed or marked N/A
- [ ] UX/accessibility risks are addressed or marked N/A
- [ ] Performance/observability risks are addressed or marked N/A
- [ ] ADR added or waived for material decisions
- [ ] Documentation updated where behavior changed

## Agent and Tooling Safety

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private data are included
- [ ] External connector actions are read-only or explicitly approved
- [ ] No active CI/scanner/release automation was added unless stack and owners
      exist
- [ ] No community Spec Kit extension or preset was installed without explicit
      approval
